identity.title: Separate ROI unset and invalid meanings at validation and runtime boundaries

origin.kind: scheduled 2D task execution and source review
origin.summary: 2D-010 requires intentional full-image/unset ROI state to remain distinct from malformed, empty, negative, overflow, and out-of-bounds ROI input across shared validation, execution, and direct tool paths.

state.current_summary: USE_ROI=false remains intentional full-image/unset state. With USE_ROI=true, shared validation rejects missing, malformed, non-positive, and negative-coordinate ROI definitions; the execution boundary rejects partial and overflow out-of-bounds rectangles; direct EdgeDetection and HsvMask execution rejects invalid ROI without clipping or silently falling back to the full image. Public save/reopen ROI text and valid multi-ROI definitions remain covered.

claims.text: VisionPipelineExecutionService previously converted malformed or missing ROI text to a default zero rectangle, ValidateRoi accepted zero width or height as a non-error, and EdgeDetection/HsvMask clamped malformed or out-of-bounds values so invalid ROI could become full-image execution.

problem.impact: An operator-authored invalid ROI could be treated as unset or clipped, changing the inspected region without an explicit failure and making UI, Runner, and direct Tool semantics diverge.

criteria.text: VisionPipelineValidator rejects malformed, missing, non-positive, and negative-coordinate CvROI/CvROIS definitions when USE_ROI=true while USE_ROI=false preserves intentional full-image/unset behavior.

VisionPipelineExecutionService rejects partial and overflow out-of-bounds ROI at the image boundary, and direct EdgeDetection/HsvMask execution rejects malformed or out-of-bounds ROI without clipping or full-image fallback.

Focused ROI meaning contract, public fixture regression smoke, and affected Debug builds pass; valid multi-ROI and save/reopen CvROI behavior remain intact, with no Original repository or external mutation.

context.location: VisionPipelineValidator.ValidateParameters -> ValidateRoiParameters; VisionPipelineExecutionService.ValidateStepInput -> ValidateRoi; VisionPipelineEdgeDetectionTool.Execute/TryResolveRoi and VisionPipelineHsvMaskTool.Execute/TryResolveRoi own direct-tool ROI admission; VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke PipelineRoiMeaningContract owns the focused corpus contract.

VisionPipelineValidator owns definition-level Errors; VisionPipelineExecutionService owns image-boundary runtime rejection; direct EdgeDetection/HsvMask tools own their raw parameter admission; VisionToolStorage/fixture smoke retain authored CvROI through save/reopen.

VisionPipelineValidation.cs -> VisionPipelineExecutionService.cs -> VisionPipelineEdgeDetectionTool.cs and VisionPipelineHsvMaskTool.cs -> PipelineRoiMeaningContract.cs -> OpenVisionFixtureSmoke/Program.cs -> stable feature contracts and current handoff.

evidence.observation: Source review confirmed the previous default-rectangle and clipping paths. The changed owners now keep USE_ROI=false as the only full-image/unset route and reject invalid ROI syntax, dimensions, coordinates, overflow, or image bounds at the appropriate boundary.

The focused contract passed: malformed CvROI with USE_ROI=false preserved full-image mask count, valid 4x4 ROI produced the expected region, malformed/zero-width/negative-coordinate definitions failed pre-validation, partial and overflow out-of-bounds values failed at runtime, direct EdgeDetection/HsvMask rejected malformed ROI, and valid multi-ROI definition retention passed.

Public fixture smoke passed with typed pre-validation rejection for missing-frame, multi-ROI, and duplicate-frame invalid fixtures, unchanged public Good/Bad outcomes, and save/reload CvROI values preserved for both the regular and public fixture pipelines.

VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke and OpenVisionFixtureSmoke Debug builds completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors. No desktop EXE or WPF UI runtime was launched in this slice; theme, DPI, monitor, and native hardware coverage remain unverified.

events.summary: Choose one Reject policy. Reuse the existing Validator, execution validation, and direct Tool owners; do not add a generic ROI service, clip invalid rectangles, or change the intentional USE_ROI=false full-image meaning.
PL-0068 resolved after the ROI meaning contract, public fixture regression smoke, and affected Debug builds passed with the Reject policy and no Original or external mutation.
